info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API allows users to efficiently access and list all documents associated with insurance claims. Designed for insurance companies and claims processors, this API streamlines the management of claim-related documents, promoting transparency and thorough documentation. Users can retrieve detailed information on documents submitted for various claims, enhancing data accessibility for audits or reviews. This API is particularly useful for applications that require real-time access to claim documentation for operational decision-making and compliance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve all documents associated with claims. It is useful for fetching necessary documentation for review or processing.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving claim documents. It should include the necessary parameters to filter and fetch the specific documents related to claims.

200.description: Successful retrieval of documents related to claims.
